title: Hydrogenation over a packed bed
protocol: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
